decisions.reason: Launched only in 2024, the combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine still has unresolved uncertainty and builds on the core offer, so keeping it costs little, though the firm's quick removal of four robots in 2024 shows it prunes machinery listings readily.
Production analysis software has low carrying costs, complements the firm's automation and lifecycle strategy, and has had no time to resolve its value, so the option is worth keeping.
